correctness.rationale: The prime reciprocal sum diverges because log(sigma_-1(a_k)) <= 2 sum_{l|a_k}1/l and the chain eventually contains any finite prime-product modulus P. For l coprime to 2ACDelta, the nonzero-root count is (l-1)(1+chi_l), giving independent Bernoulli parameters (1+chi_l)/(l-1). The signed statistic T has mean >=H and variance <=3H on unit prime pairs, versus mean 0 and variance <=H on arbitrary residues. Fixed-modulus PNT in progressions plus Chebyshev controls the represented values; terms with a bounded small index cost O(X(log X)^(-2/r)), and all-large shifts preserve T. Taking a finite modulus with H arbitrarily large establishes zero upper density. Independently checked 55 residue cases from six forms and ten odd primes. Critical r>=3 construction a_k=k! 2^{ceil(k^{r/2})} has log a_k asymptotic k^{r/2} log 2. Finite checks cannot replace the PNT-based argument.
